in_marathi.name: Krunal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krunal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Krura’, meaning ‘crown’ or ‘rule’, Krunal is a powerful and regal name. In Hindu mythology, Krunal is the name of various gods and goddesses, each embodying different aspects of power and rule.
